create_transformer_model: create a compiled Keras transformer model with configurable embedding dim, attention heads, and blocks
build_model_with_sgd: build a transformer model using the SGD optimizer with a custom learning rate
create_model_with_adamw: create a transformer model using the AdamW optimizer with weight decay for training
get_optimizer_adamw: get an AdamW optimizer instance with a specified learning rate and default weight decay
get_optimizer_sgd: get an SGD optimizer instance with a specified learning rate for model training
